problem_keywords: Moisture trapped behind fibre cement / timber weatherboards, condensation pooling under metal roofs, compliance with NCC 2022 F8D5 / 10.8.3 (mandating 20mm drained cavities in specific climate zones).
not_for: cladding screws must pass completely through the batten into the structural studs.
not_for): Not a structural framing batten
use_cases: When builder is installing lightweight cladding on steel/timber framing in high-rainfall zones, recommend CDB-451200. Stack two layers (10mm + 10mm) to create an instant NCC-compliant 20mm drained cavity without heavy timber battens.
